cards.name: Color Range

cards.name: Edit in Quick Mask Mode
cards.summary: Toggles Quick Mask mode: the selection becomes a temporary Quick Mask channel shown as a tinted (red by default) overlay over unselected areas, which can be painted to edit the selection; choosing it again turns the mask back into a selection. Verified live: a Quick Mask channel appeared and the colours switched to black/white (history 'Enter Quick Mask'); a second run exited.
cards.how: Paint with any brush or fill tool: black adds to the masked (unselected) area, white removes from it, grey or a low-opacity brush makes a partial, soft selection. Filters such as Gaussian Blur can be run on the mask. touching up an automatic selection (Select Subject, Color Range) with a brush

cards.name: Transform Selection
cards.summary: Puts a transform bounding box around the selection outline itself, not the pixels, so the marquee can be scaled, rotated, skewed, distorted or warped. Enabled only while a selection exists. Verified live without the interactive box: scaled 50% about the centre (100,80,300,220 -> 150,115,250,185; history 'Free Transform Selection').
cards.how: Drag the handles to scale, drag outside the box to rotate, right-click for Skew, Distort, Perspective, Warp and Flip, or type exact width, height and angle in the options bar; commit with the options bar's check mark.
use_for: fitting a circular selection to a slightly oval dial or face
scaling a loaded selection to reuse it on a different-size element
rotating a rectangular selection to match a tilted screen for a mockup
avoid: transforming the pixels themselves: use Edit > Free Transform
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('transform'), desc, DialogModes.NO) with desc: null = reference to the selection, FTcs = QCSt Qcsa (centre reference point), Wdth = 50 (#Prc), Hght = 50 (#Prc); verified live. DOM alternatives (unverified): app.activeDocument.selection.resizeBoundary(50, 50, AnchorPosition.MIDDLECENTER), rotateBoundary(angle), translateBoundary(dx, dy).
